receipt_storage: Receipt headers and selected related raw event logs only; receipt_sha256 is SHA256 of full parsed receipt serialized with Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)).
selection: Lexicographically smallest TradeAction id for each of order types 2,3,4,6,7 in 2024-03-29 smoke extract; not a random sample.
validation: Five transaction receipt/header comparisons passed for execution log index, protocol account, order key, market, type, exact raw USD size, timestamp, and four fee fields. Decoded results derived from retained raw log bytes using ABI dynamic offsets; address/uint/bytes32 scalar item groups only.
